description: This Java file defines an abstract class 'ResourceLoader' responsible for dynamically loading resources via different resource loader implementations within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading resources, retrieving URLs, parsing XML configuration files for resource loader definitions, and caching loaded documents and loaders.

classes.name: ResourceLoader
classes.description: An abstract class for resource loaders that provides methods for loading resources, retrieving XML configuration, and managing loader instances with caching mechanisms.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads a resource as an InputStream based on the filename, location, and loader name.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL of a resource given the filename, location, and loader name.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Retrieves a ResourceLoader instance from cache or creates a new one based on the XML configuration.

methods.name: getXmlRootElement
methods.description: Deprecated method to obtain root XML element of a resource. Uses cached Document.

methods.name: readXmlRootElement
methods.description: Reads and returns the root element of an XML resource.

methods.name: invalidateDocument
methods.description: Clears cached XML documents related to a specific configuration file.

methods.name: getXmlDocument
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve cached XML Document for a resource.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Reads and returns an XML Document object from a resource filename.

methods.name: makeLoader
methods.description: Creates a ResourceLoader instance based on the loader's XML configuration element.

methods.name: fullLocation
methods.description: Constructs the full resource location string, incorporating environment variables and prefix.
